_comment: Limits for the digitalocean target. Baked at image build time and copied to /etc/deputyos/limits.json. Schema in deputyctl/src/limits.rs. Sized for the s-2vcpu-4gb default droplet (4 GB RAM, block storage). Larger droplets override at runtime via deputyctl doctor's live RAM probe.

limitations.reason: DigitalOcean droplets have no audio device; voice features disabled
limitations.unblock: deploy on rpi5 8GB+ or x86_64-mini-pc for voice

limitations.reason: RAM tier 'standard' (4 GB) below local-LLM threshold (8 GB working set)
limitations.unblock: upgrade to s-4vcpu-8gb or larger; or use a cloud model provider

limitations.reason: DigitalOcean droplets are single-slot; rollback is via DO snapshot rotation, not A/B partitions
limitations.unblock: DO maintains 7-day automatic snapshots on enabled droplets; restore from there

limitations.reason: DigitalOcean meters egress bandwidth; deputyOS does not control or rate-limit it
limitations.unblock: monitor in DO dashboard; cap channels' attachment-fetch frequency in wizard
